entries.question: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
entries.answer: Scope: extend the standalone qif-ledger schema, example, verifier, retained negative fixtures, documentation, AI guide, roadmap, portable package, changelog, and release. Out of scope: UI, external integrations, provider-specific memory stores, employee surveillance, automatic authority, and real operational claims.
